title: Maximum Number of Achievable Transfer Requests
description: Find the maximum number of requests that can be fulfilled such that the net change in each building's population is zero.

steps.note: Initialize recursion with index 0, count 0, and net change array [0,0]. Requests: [[0,1], [1,0]]
Move to index 1. Include request [1, 0]. Net change becomes [0, 0].
Reached index 2. All net changes are 0. Valid count is 2.
